findings.location: Paragraph beginning "As I write this, I am flying 35,000 feet..."
findings.source_quote: "The stark contrast between the landscape described in the previous paragraphs and the parched desert land hurrying by six miles below me is nearly beyond my comprehension."
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the original distance without introducing Swedish 'mil' (10 km). Use a literal rendering such as: "...och den uttorkade ökenmarken som skyndar förbi sex miles under mig är nästan bortom min förståelse." Alternatively give a metric conversion in parentheses: "sex miles (ca 9,7 km) under mig". Preserve the original numeric value and unit meaning.
findings.translation_quote: "...den uttorkade ökenmarken som skyndar förbi sex mil under mig är nästan bortom min förståelse."

findings.location: Paragraph beginning "Most people in this area are Muslims."
findings.source_quote: "They fast from food and water every day from dawn to dusk, even though daytime temperatures exceed 110 degrees."
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the temperature unit so it does not change the factual meaning. The source implies Fahrenheit; do not leave it as ambiguous Swedish 'grader' (which is normally interpreted as Celsius). Suggest one of: 1) Keep the unit explicit: "...även om dagstemperaturerna överstiger 110 °F (ca 43 °C)." 2) Convert accurately and state the converted value: "...även om dagstemperaturerna överstiger cirka 43 °C (110 °F)." Preserve the original numeric magnitude and indicate units.
